## Note
This site is the Daily Workflow Library: 8 prompts, no account. Not the Hub. The full course application lives at the main product URL above.

## Design System (v2.0.1)
- SSOT: `css/tokens.css` | Docs: `docs/design_system.md`
- Brand colors: gold `#CFA73A`, navy `#0B1320`, teal `#008579`
- Components: `css/library.css` (imports tokens) | Privacy: `css/privacy.css`
- Rules: no inline hex colors; use semantic tokens (`--color-link`, `--color-action-primary-bg`, `--color-focus-ring`)
- Patterns: LibraryPage layout (hero → prompts → ritual-complete → next-steps → community → footer); CTA hierarchy (navy primary → badge → teal chips → community teal → earned course outline)
- Validation: `npm run validate:tokens`, `npm run lint:design-tokens`
- Machine-readable export: `tokens/tokens.json` (W3C DTCG 2025.10)
